added_lines: . please note that accord derry will not be facilitating courses during october or december 2026. feast days monday 29th june: st. peter and st. paul were important apostles of jesus christ, with distinct backgrounds and roles. st. peter, an ordinary man, one of the original twelve disciples, was chosen by jesus and considered the ‘rock’ upon which the church was to be built. st. peter was martyred in rome, likely during nero’s persecution. st. paul, initially a persecutor of christians, underwent a dramatic conversion and became ‘apostle to the gentiles’, a zealous missionary spreading christianity and a prolific writer whose scripts and letters are foundational to christian theology. st. paul was martyred in rome, likely around the same time as st. peter. their joint feast signifies their remarkable commitment to spreading the gospel; their grace and courage to bear witness and the wisdom to shape the early church. tuesday 30th june: the first martyrs of the see of rome when the city of rome had been devastated by fire in the year 64, the emperor nero launched a persecution against the christians, who were thrown to the wild beasts in the arena or soaked in tar and used as living torches. their deaths are documented in the writings of the roman historian tacitus and in pope st. clement’s letter to the corinthians. their feast was celebrated the day after the feast of saints peter and paul. community news save the date: the svp outing will be on thursday 20th august to doagh famine village, ballyliffin, co. donegal. more details regarding pick up times, places and itinerary will follow closer to the time. a contribution of £20 p.p. will be much appreciated. please make contact with a conference member if you are interested in joining us for the outing on that day …we would look forward to having you… thank you for your continued support. svp banagher. st. mary’s gac, banagher: lotto numbers for 23.06.26 were 6, 19, 24 & 26. winning £10 each were bridget kealey, breidge doherty, richard mcgrisken, marie o’neill, kateri lynch, raicheal o’kane, karen milligan x 2, danielle mcglynn, and ramon mclaughlin. next week’s jackpot is £9,200. glenshane house: floral candle holder workshop facilitated by pauline on tuesday 30th june 11.00am – 1.00pm and 7.00pm – 9.00pm. fee including all materials only £5. to book either workshop, tel.
